name: COZ Summer Camp
operator_name: Bristol Warren Regional School District (Bristol Warren Family Resource Center, COZ Program)
street_address: Hugh Cole Elementary School, 50 Asylum Road
description_short: A school-district day camp at Hugh Cole Elementary School in Warren, RI, for children entering kindergarten through grade six. Campers do art, music, science, sports, community service, fitness, gardening and reading. Families can sign up for one day, one week or the whole summer.
